bounds.on_bound: stop, write results and receipt with completion_status stopped_on_bound; completed windows are kept

count_rule.also_recorded: sum of the 10x duplicate-count column (col5) and number of distinct barcodes in the window
count_rule.beyond_last_interval: tile index >= number of linear entries => count 0 with status beyond_last_interval
count_rule.index_use: linear index of the .tbi: read from the virtual offset of the 16 kb tile containing window start; stop when a record start >= window end or the chromosome changes; bins are not used
count_rule.sortedness: a start smaller than the previous start on the target chromosome refuses the window (unsorted_refused)
count_rule.unit: fragment rows overlapping the window: start < window_end and end > window_start

frozen_before: any target-window read; only HEAD, fixed 0-1023 byte Range and one index download (0dpa1 .tbi.gz) were made before this file

google_contract.COPS_OUT: fresh output directory; source cwd is a new isolated directory

inputs.controls: engineering/reg_proxy/controls.json (Table S4D, GRCz11; sha256 of source xlsx inside)
inputs.libraries: 10 fragment files + 10 .tbi.gz, URLs and Content-Length pinned in controls.json

not_claimed: accessibility is not sequence function, enhancer activity or same-cell RNA/ATAC pairing
no p-value, threshold, rank or pass/fail on 'positives exceed negative' (one negative control cannot calibrate)
LEN is excluded: exact GRCz11 interval unresolved (source is Zv9); no inferred window
no cell-type split (labels are not in GEO)
two libraries per time point is n=2; no inference
question: For each of the 10 GSE261907 snATAC libraries (5 time points x 2 biological replicates), how many fragments overlap each source-validated reporter-positive amplicon, the one source reporter-negative amplicon, and size-matched positional comparison windows? Descriptive library counts only.

summary_rule.excluded: windows with status other than ok/beyond_last_interval are listed and excluded from summaries, never imputed
summary_rule.per_library_context: count, count per kb, and count divided by the median of that window's own two comparison-window counts (undefined if the median is 0; recorded as null)
summary_rule.replicates: both replicates listed side by side for each time point with absolute difference; no pooling, no test

synthetic_controls: engineering/reg_proxy/controls_synth.py runs the same index parser, block reader, counter and transport class on generated BGZF+tabix-style fixtures, a brute-force oracle, a local Range server and the real 0dpa1 index bytes

transport.attempts: every attempt logged; the second attempt exists because intermittent IncompleteRead was observed in 2 of ~6 probe requests; this is a declared policy, not a hidden retry; no other retry
transport.range_required: HTTP 206 with Content-Range exactly bytes a-b/total equal to the pinned file size and body length b-a+1; anything else is a failed attempt (unsupported_range / range_mismatch / short_read)

windows.chrom_name_rule: use the index sequence name equal to the control chrom ('chr24'); if absent record window status chrom_absent; no alias mapping

comparison_windows.must_not_overlap: any amplicon or other comparison window; checked at build and in preflight, refusal otherwise
comparison_windows.purpose: candidate-independent positional noise-floor context, not a library-size normaliser
comparison_windows.rule: for every amplicon, two windows of identical length on the same chromosome at +250000 and +500000 bp from its 0-based start

windows.convention: 1-based inclusive in source -> 0-based half-open [start-1,end) (BED-like, matches tabix format 65536 observed in the real index)
